thread:
Hana (partnerships): Quick thread to propose a lightweight SI co-sell convention: claim rules, account mapping, marketplace/hw SKU linking, and announcement gating. Short replies please.
Leo (sales): Sales wants deterministic ownership. Suggest: 36h soft-claim for SI; if SI uploads LOA or sets visibility-lock, they get exclusive 4 days. After soft-claim, AE auto-assign.
Pri (solutions): visibility-lock sounds good. It should include an expires_at and a small reason field so we know if it's discovery vs scheduled demo. Also request a partner_claim_score to surface priority (manual).
Marco (marketplace): For private marketplace bundles we need market_offer_id + hw_bundle_sku and credited_partner_id. Also want marketplace_billing_code to reconcile rebates.
Tess (legal): Legal: LOA template + Partner Announcement Addendum OK. Recommend partner signoff window = 5 business days. LOAs must include signer name + role.
Hana (partnerships): Intake fields to add: partner_tag, visibility_lock, lock_expires_at, loa_url, partner_claim_score, marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_sku, marketplace_billing_code. Example intake webhook (single-line for brevity):
```json
{"lead_id":"L-2024-9001","account":"Maple Inc","partner_tag":"si-horizon","visibility_lock":true,"lock_expires_at":"2024-08-12T16:00:00Z","loa_url":"https://s3.redwood/loas/9001.pdf","partner_claim_score":"70","marketplace_offer_id":"gcp-private-9001","hw_bundle_sku":"NVIDIA-EDGE-STD","marketplace_billing_code":"MB-901"}
```
Pri (solutions): Conflict resolution: priority order = (valid LOA signed) > (visibility_lock true & earlier lock_ts) > (partner_claim_score) > (partner_tier). Surface conflict to #partnerships with quick actions (claim, release, escalate).
Leo (sales): Attribution: marketplace-origin deals set sf_origin = marketplace_offer_id and sf_credited_ae = assigned_ae. If AE doesn't engage within 24h of assignment, revert to partnerships queue. Also any deal >= $275k triggers Sales Ops + Partnerships review.
Marco (marketplace): We'll add marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_sku, marketplace_billing_code, and credited_partner_id to daily export. ETA 3 business days. We'll include marketplace_origin boolean for SFDC mapping.
Tess (legal): I'll post LOA and announcement addendum drafts to the partnership drive. Also adding a short IP/logo permission checkbox to the intake flow.
intake-bot: Note: intake schema will accept new optional fields. PR: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/678
Hana (partnerships): Action items: Pri - formalize conflict logic + quick-action UX; Marco - update exports; Leo - propose SFDC field names; Tess - post legal templates; I'll assemble a 1-page "SI Co-sell + Marketplace" playbook and run a 20-min review Friday 9:30am PT.
Leo (sales): 9:30am PT works. Can we make the $275k threshold configurable per-region? Some regions have different seat pricing.
Pri (solutions): Yes, make escalation threshold env-configurable. Also logging: keep claim audit for 120 days for investigation.
Hana (partnerships): Great. I'll drop a draft playbook before the meeting and link the intake PR. Thanks all :)
